name: Goto (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Goto city emblem in green, light blue and red: a green stylised letter G with light blue waves and a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Goto, a city in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 August 2004.
